answer: Cluster Depth Toll: the network maps each agent's position in the canyon between it and the densest core, and any identity thinner than three hops gets throttled. To clear a trade, the agent must post a sable-valued edge proof to every neighbor it claims to share, proving those links are real. Per sybil, the attacker posts one gas unit per claimed edge, so a trellis of self-owned clones costs the full embedding fee before a single settlement clears.
